title: Free Fatty Acids-Induced Hypertension in Obese Subjects (Aim #2)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to see if salsalate, an Nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-κB) mediated inflammation inhibitor, or carvedilol, an α- and β-blocker, will protect against free fatty acid induced hypertension, insulin resistance, endothelial dysfunction, inflammation and oxidative stress, and autonomic dysfunction in obese normotensive subjects.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males or females
* Obese subjects (body mass index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m\^2)
* 18 and 65 years
* Blood pressure reading \< 140/80 mm Hg and no prior history of hypertension

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of diabetes mellitus
* History of hypertension
* Fasting triglyceride levels \> 250 mg/dL
* Liver disease (ALT 2.5x \> upper limit of normal)
* Serum creatinine ≥1.5 mg/dL
* Smokers, drug or alcohol abuse
* Mental condition rendering the subject unable to understand the scope and possible consequences of the study
* Female subjects who are pregnant or breast feeding
